title: Tunisian Tagine with Hearty Vegetables
description: A flavorful and aromatic stew originating from Tunisia, made with hearty vegetables and served over bamboo shoots.

ingredients.name: Tomato paste
ingredients.notes: Tunisian tagine is known for its umami flavor, use tomato paste to add depth.

ingredients.name: Tunisian spice blend
ingredients.notes: A mix of cumin, coriander, and cinnamon will give your tagine its authentic flavor.

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large, heavy pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
Add the carrots, potatoes, and red bell pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until they begin to soften, about 5 minutes.
Add the tomato paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes.
Add the vegetable broth, Tunisian spice blend, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Add the bamboo shoots and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
